steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****, What a fierce gal! This is a ******* mini version of Zoya!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Don't back away. Her power is a far cry from Zoya's, and she is injured. We can take care of her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: But she's in a different league from street thugs as far as battle experience is concerned. Plus the way she fights, going all out... I couldn't even take one blow from her ax.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This is a demon bear all right, one capable of changing into human form! No doubt her shortness is a deception used for tricking her opponents!
Hardly has Hella finished her sentence when she is sent flying by the blunt side of the ax. Hecate immediately jumps in front of you.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You are their leader? Where did you capture these new Sinners to force them to fight?! You can't defeat Zoya, so you stoop to this!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You're despicable, you bastard gangsters! Who do you think you are, plotting against the Legion, against my boss?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Is she under the influence of Mania? She is overexcited, but there's still a chance of bringing her out of it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Let me handle her. Chief, please find an opening to put the shackles on her, and do it fast!
The ax makes the earth shudder and beats back Nightmare. Horo's aura overwhelms everyone. Her unwavering determination to fight comes from her absolute loyalty to the Legion and Zoya.
People like her will not bow down to you even if they are defeated and shackled. This being the case, you decide to change tack...

options: Stop it! We're all on Zoya's side!

steps.content: Before she can get the word out, you take a step forward and plants yourself in front of Hecate.
Horo's ax halts in mid-air, and you look into her eyes and talk in a measured tone.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We are free citizens from the Syndicate... We are mercenaries. We have been commissioned by the Legion to come down here to save you.
